BiblicalUsage: Paramythion occurs once: if there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies, fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse gathers the whole Christian comfort: consolation in Christ, comfort of love, fellowship of the Spirit — and it all ends in unity.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
